item.title: [SwiftHFR] LOT-166 PR 1: seasonal scheduler, Noël soft and the arrival alert
item.body:
LOT-166
Refs #256 (PR 1 of 4 of the minimal slice). Moved from the issue's PR 1 row to PR 2: piled snow (on cards and the bottom edge), the Instruments figures on a device, and a per-column snow band clear of large titles. Left for PRs 2–4: sleigh and crossing objects, elves, Noël abusé after LOT-188.
Claim: mac/M1

## Problem
Legacy had a Christmas mode (red accent, snow in the navigation bar, a one-time alert) hard-coded to 24/12/2022–09/01/2023 and forced off at every launch (`Classes/HFRplusAppDelegate.m:103, 365, 627-677` @ 87fe0d1c), so SwiftHFR has nothing for December. The operator wants Noël soft on by default on 01/12 (THEMES.md §5), in the TestFlight build before then.

## Cause
No seasonal engine: nothing knows the windows, nothing saves and restores the user's theme, no settings for it.

## Change
- **Keys** (HFRStorage, additive): `season.automatic`, `season.animations` in the catalogue (device scope), and per-season `season.noel.<year>.arrivalShown|optedOut|previousThemeID|packingShown` from `SettingKey+Seasons.swift` (device scope, outside the static catalogue since there is one set per year). ADR 0013 matrix E rows added (placed away from #829's `theme_id` row to avoid a conflict; `SettingKey.swift` is touched additively at its end, as #829 also edits it).
- **Scheduler** (`SeasonalThemeModel`, `@Observable @MainActor`, injected clock, calendar and Reduce Motion): called on every scene activation; once per season it plays the arrival (switching Noël soft on 01/12–24/12 unless opted out or automatic is off) or the packing (27/12–02/01), restores silently afterwards, and restores a theme left on from any earlier season (`season.noel.activeYear` pointer). `NoelCalendar` holds the windows: Gregorian dates in the device's time zone, whatever its calendar.
- **Noël soft** (built on today's appearance model, LOT-122; #829's token model is not forked): legacy's `.red` accent (`HFRswift/Swift/Common.swift:610-612, 625-627` @ 87fe0d1c) drawn over the user's appearance by `ThemeAppearance.applying(_:)` in `appTheme`, never stored, so turning it off gives the theme and accent back exactly. Light procedural snow (`SnowField`, `Canvas` + paused `TimelineView`, 30 fps cap) between the bars, no hit testing, hidden from VoiceOver; no piled snow yet (a drift drawn over the content crossed row text in the screenshots: PR 2 puts it on cards). Legacy's snow frames are not shipped: no stated origin or licence.
- **Réglages › Thème**: « Thèmes de saison » section only inside 01/12–26/12 (as legacy's cell, `Classes/PlusSettingsViewController.m:112-115`), with « Thème habituel » / « Noël soft » and the two toggles.
- **Arrival alert**: « Oh Oh Oh ! » / « Thème disponible dans les réglages » [OK] [Désactiver], a system alert (spoken). It stays pending until answered, across launches (`season.noel.<year>.arrivalPending`); it is presented only when no lock, sheet, composer, other alert or keyboard is up (THEMES.md §4 rule 5), and by one scene when the iPad shows two windows (`SeasonalArrivalAlert`). No sleigh yet (PR 2).
- Spec `docs/lots/LOT-166-seasonal-noel.md` (points to THEMES.md).

Why this wide: the whole PR 1 row of the issue's minimal slice; nothing of PRs 2–4.

## Tests
Swift Testing, injected clock (`SeasonTestClock`, Europe/Paris), no waiting except the real-window tint test.
- `NoelCalendarTests`: each acceptance date (30/11, 01/12, 24/12, 25/12, 26/12, 27/12, 31/12, 01/01, 02/01, 03/01) has its phase and season; local midnight; selectable days.
- `SeasonalThemeModelTests`: first launch on 30/11 (nothing, section hidden), 01/12 and 24/12 (switched on + alert), 25/12 and 26/12 (alert, nothing switched on), 27/12–02/01 (packing), 03/01 (silent restore, no red first frame); packing launch without a theme; last season's theme restored before the new arrival; two launches the same day; two packing launches; « Désactiver » (restore + opt-out for the year, fresh next year); OK; manual pick on 26/12 then packed on 27/12; manual turn-off; no pick outside the window; automatic off; Reduce Motion; « Animations de saison » off; snow only with a theme on.
- `SeasonalThemeRestoreTests`: every catalogue key's raw value unchanged after « Désactiver » and after packing; Noël soft's red over the user's dark style and brightness.
- `SeasonalAppThemeTests`: in a real window, picking Noël soft tints the window red and turning it off gives the user's accent back.
- `SnowFieldTests`: flakes stay inside the area at any time, light and deterministic, move with time, nothing for an empty area or a NaN time.
- HFRKit: `SettingKeyTests` (key names, defaults, the per-season keys), `SettingScopeTests` (matrix with the two toggles, per-season keys device-only).

Shown red: the HFRKit tests failed to compile before the keys existed, and `theNoelSeasonKeysStayOnTheDevice` failed with one key turned `.synced`; the app tests failed against a mutated build where the scheduler, `select`, `answerArrival`, `applying`, the calendar and the snow wrap were no-ops (22 of the 29 app tests failed; the 7 that passed are the negative cases where doing nothing is the expected result, e.g. 30/11 or no pick outside the window).

Local runs (`CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO`, iOS 27.0 simulators): `xcodebuild build test` on 00a28dd7: iPhone 18 Pro 1385/1386 (`TopicRowActionsTests.aRemovalInFlightIsNotSentTwice`, a known load flake untouched by this PR, passed alone, 15/15), iPad Pro 11-inch M5 1386/1386, counts from the xcresult bundles; HFRKit `swift test` green (all suites). Screenshots (Réglages › Thème inside and outside the window, Noël soft light and dark, the alert) are in the author's work folder, from in-memory fixtures only.

Round 2 (Fable round 1): new tests `SeasonalArrivalTests` (kill before seen, dropped when the window closes, held by lock / sheet / keyboard, one scene of two) and `SeasonalSweepTests` (2026 → 2028, 2026 → Feb 2029, pointer cleared by packing, Buddhist and Japanese device calendars), each shown red against a mutated model (8/8 failed across two mutation runs).

Round 3 (Fable round 2, two Low): the zone is read at each use (`timeZone` closure, default `.autoupdatingCurrent`), and any other season's theme is restored (`activeYear != year`); tests `SeasonalSweepTests.aTimeZoneChangeDuringARunIsFollowed` and `aThemeSwitchedOnUnderAClockAheadIsRestoredWhenTheClockGoesBack`, both red first.

Open points for the operator: (1) with « Thèmes de saison automatiques » off the arrival alert still shows (as on 25/12) but switches nothing on; (2) falling snow is kept out of fixed 56 pt / 64 pt bands for the bars, which PR 2 will refine per column.

### Ledger

```gap-edit
GAP-147
Legacy ref: ThemeManager.m:213-244; Common.swift:469-473 @ 2440d79; HFRplusAppDelegate.m:627-677 (forced off at :103, :365); ThemeManager.m:213-245; Common.swift:610-627; HFRNavigationController.m:85-90, 134-139; HFRplusAppDelegate.m:382-388; PlusSettingsViewController.m:112-115 @ 87fe0d1c
SwiftHFR final: Noël (Noël soft, Noël abusé) selectable 01/12–26/12 on local dates every year, Noël soft switched on 01/12–24/12 unless opted out, sleigh arrival with « Oh Oh Oh ! » alert, elves packing and restore of the previous theme (silent after 02/01); Noël soft = legacy's red accent drawn over the user's theme (never stored) and procedural light snow (legacy's snow frames have no stated licence); Samain 01/10–31/10 (LOT-191); 14 July overlay (LOT-194); « Thèmes de saison automatiques » and « Animations de saison » settings (docs/THEMES.md §4–§5).
```

comments.body:
**Adversarial review (Fable 5.1), round 1 on 51a4cb69: REQUEST CHANGES**

1. **Medium** — `App/SwiftHFR/Settings/Seasons/SeasonalThemeModel.swift:88-92`. Only `year - 1` is swept. Noël soft on 10/12/2026, app next opened 05/12/2028 (or 05/02/2029): `season.noel.2026.previousThemeID` stays stored forever, no `restoredSilently(2026)` (probe: events = `[arrival(2028)]`, then `[]`). Spec: "silent restore at the next activation, including a year later". With LOT-188 (PR 4) the saved `theme_id` of an older season would never be written back. Fix: sweep every earlier season (a `season.noel.activeYear` pointer, or a bounded loop), with a test.
2. **Medium** — `SeasonalThemeModel.swift:95-96` + `SeasonalDecorations.swift:28-37`. `arrivalShown` is set when the alert is *queued*; `pendingAlert` is memory only. 01/12: theme switched on, alert gated by the lock cover or not presentable because a sheet/composer is up (rule 5: the gate only checks the lock), iOS kills the app → next launch has Noël soft on and the user never sees « Oh Oh Oh ! » nor « Désactiver » (probe: `second.pendingAlert == nil`). Fix: persist the pending arrival (set `arrivalShown` in `answerArrival`, or an `arrivalPending` key), and gate on sheets/keyboard as rule 5 requires.
3. **Low** — `NoelCalendar.swift:23-39`, default `Calendar.autoupdatingCurrent`. On a Buddhist/Japanese device `seasonYear` is 2569 / Reiwa 8 → keys `season.noel.2569.*`, contrary to the ADR 0013 row ("year of its December"); switching the calendar setting inside the window replays the arrival and orphans the key (probe: 2569). Fix: Gregorian calendar with `TimeZone.autoupdatingCurrent`.
4. **Low** — legacy pointers: the hard-coded dates are `HFRplusAppDelegate.m:635-636` @ 87fe0d1c (not `:633-634`, `NoelCalendar.swift:4`, spec), the alert `:665-676` (`:645` is `noel_first_time_2022`; `SeasonalDecorations.swift:4`, spec). Other citations verified.
5. **Detail** — iPad two windows: both scenes present the same alert; answering one dismisses the other. Say so in the spec or present on one scene.
6. **Detail** — #829: textual conflicts only (`SettingKey.all`, `SettingKeyTests`, `SettingScopeTests`); no model fork, `legacyThemeID = "legacy"` matches `theme_id` nil → Legacy.
7. **Detail** — issue PR-1 scope (piled snow, Instruments numbers) deferred to PR 2: fine for `Refs`, say it on the issue table. Large-title bars (~96 pt) exceed the 56 pt band: flakes cross the title text, not the buttons.

**Verified**: worktree at 51a4cb69; HFRKit `swift test` (SettingKey/SettingScope, 29 green); app build + 29 PR tests green on an iPhone 18 Pro iOS 27.0 simulator (xcresult count), including the window tint test; 4 probes failed as described; 3 mutations (window `1...23`, no `optedOut` write, night accent untouched) each caught by the matching test (4 failures / 24); `ledger.py check-body --labels ledger`: 1 block ok, GAP-147 edit consistent with the "SwiftHFR final" column; no added line > 140; accent readers all go through the environment.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Round 1 fixes in `046e0c0b` (one commit), replying to the Fable verdict above:

1. **Medium, earlier seasons**: fixed. `season.noel.activeYear` (device scope, in `SettingKey.all`, the `SettingKeyTests`/`SettingScopeTests` matrices and the ADR 0013 row) is set when a Noël theme is switched on and cleared on restore; each activation restores the season it names when it is earlier than today's. Tests `SeasonalSweepTests.aThemeLeftOnTwoSeasonsAgoIsRestoredBeforeTheNewArrival` (2026 → 05/12/2028), `aThemeLeftOnSinceDecember2026IsRestoredInFebruary2029`, `packingClearsThePointer`.
2. **Medium, arrival lost**: fixed. `season.noel.<year>.arrivalPending` is set with `arrivalShown` and cleared only by an answer, so the alert comes back at the next launch while the window is open (dropped when it closes). The new `SeasonalArrivalAlert` asks the model every second while an arrival is pending and presents it only when the lock does not cover the screen, nothing is presented over the window's root (sheet, composer, cover, another alert) and the keyboard is down (THEMES.md §4 rule 5). Tests `SeasonalArrivalTests.anArrivalKilledBeforeItWasSeenIsShownAtTheNextLaunch`, `anArrivalNeverAnsweredIsDroppedWhenTheWindowCloses`, `theAlertWaitsWhileTheLockASheetOrTheKeyboardIsUp` (lock, sheet, keyboard).
3. **Low, calendar**: fixed. `NoelCalendar` reads Gregorian components in the given calendar's time zone, and the model keeps a Gregorian calendar in the device's time zone (`TimeZone.autoupdatingCurrent` through `Calendar.autoupdatingCurrent`). Test `SeasonalSweepTests.seasonYearsAreGregorianWhateverTheDeviceCalendar` (Buddhist, Japanese).
4. **Low, citations**: fixed in code and spec: dates `HFRplusAppDelegate.m:635-636`, alert `:665-676`, `noel_first_time_2022` `:645-651` @ 87fe0d1c.
5. **Detail, two windows**: one scene presents the alert; another gets it only if the first goes away unanswered (`releaseAlert` on disappear). Test `SeasonalArrivalTests.onlyOneSceneShowsTheAlert`.
6. **Detail, #829**: agreed: textual conflicts only. Whichever lands second takes both entries in `SettingKey.all` and the two test matrices.
7. **Detail, scope and band**: the PR body now says what moves from the issue's PR 1 row to PR 2 (piled snow, Instruments figures on a device, a snow band clear of large titles); the spec says a large title is about 96 pt high and flakes may cross its text, not its buttons. Said on #256 too, as a comment (I did not edit the issue body: it is not mine).

Red first: the 8 new app tests failed against two mutated builds (sweep limited to `year - 1`, pending neither persisted nor dropped, gate always open, no scene claim, device calendar used, pointer never cleared): 6/8 then 2/2 failed. The HFRKit key tests failed to compile without the new keys.
Local, iOS 27.0, counts from the xcresult bundles: iPhone 18 Pro 1384/1384; iPad Pro 11-inch M5 1383/1384, the one failure being `ReaderSettingsWatchTests.aStartedWatchReadsNowThenFollowsEveryChangeUntilStopped` (not touched here) under a load spike, which passed alone (2/2). HFRKit `swift test`: all green. The UI did not change visibly, so the screenshots were not regenerated.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**Adversarial review (Fable 5.1), round 2 on 046e0c0b: APPROVE**

Round-1 findings 1–7 are fixed as classes: `season.noel.activeYear` sweep of any earlier season (matrix, catalogue, ADR row updated), `arrivalPending` kept across launches and dropped when the window closes, rule-5 gates (lock, presented controller, keyboard), Gregorian season years, one scene on iPad, citations (`:635-636`, `:645-651`, `:665-676` verified), PR 2 notes in the spec. Remaining, none blocking:

1. **Low** — `SeasonalThemeModel.swift:82-86` + spec "Calendar". `Calendar.autoupdatingCurrent.timeZone` is a snapshot of `TimeZone.current` (checked: `== .autoupdatingCurrent` is false), so the model's calendar is frozen at launch; a zone change during a run (travel, app resident for days) computes the window edges in the old zone until relaunch. The spec says `TimeZone.autoupdatingCurrent`. Fix: build the Gregorian calendar on `TimeZone.autoupdatingCurrent` (take a `TimeZone` parameter, default `.autoupdatingCurrent`), one line and the spec stays true.
2. **Low** — `SeasonalThemeModel.swift:96-101, 184-188`. The sweep restores `activeYear < year` only; a theme switched on under a clock running ahead (season 2027) and then corrected to 2026 gets a second switch-on: two `previousThemeID`s, one pointer (probe: both on, `activeYear = 2026`), and on 01/12/2027 Noël soft is on with no arrival (`arrivalShown(2027)` already true). Fix: sweep `active != year`, or refuse `switchOn` while `activeYear` points elsewhere.
3. **Detail** — the 1 s poll in `SeasonalArrivalAlert` is acceptable: it runs only while an arrival is pending and blocked (foreground; the process is suspended in background; the task is cancelled when the root disappears); the presentation gate has no notification, so a poll is the honest signal. `keyboardDidShow` is app-wide: on iPad a keyboard in the other window holds this one's alert; fine.
4. **Detail** — a sheet opened in the same run-loop turn as `shown = alert` could prevent the presentation with the loop ended; SwiftUI usually retries on the next update. A Mac hand check with the composer covers it.

**Verified**: worktree at 046e0c0b; HFRKit `swift test` SettingKey/SettingScope (29 green); app build + 37 Seasons tests green on an iPhone 18 Pro iOS 27.0 simulator (xcresult count), my 2 probes failing as in 1–2; 5 mutations (no `arrivalPending` write, sweep `== year - 1`, no scene guard, keyboard ignored, device calendar year) each caught by its test (6/8 red); `ledger.py check-body --labels ledger`: 1 block ok; no added line over 140.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Round 2 Lows fixed in `00a28dd7` (one commit):

1. **Time zone**: `SeasonalThemeModel` now takes `timeZone: () -> TimeZone` (default `.autoupdatingCurrent`), and the Gregorian calendar is built from it at each use, so a zone change during a run is followed. The spec says so. Test `SeasonalSweepTests.aTimeZoneChangeDuringARunIsFollowed`: 01/12 00:30 Paris, first activated under UTC (still 30/11, nothing), then under Paris (arrival).
2. **Clock set back**: the sweep restores any other season's theme (`activeYear != year`) before this season runs, so two `previousThemeID`s never coexist. Test `SeasonalSweepTests.aThemeSwitchedOnUnderAClockAheadIsRestoredWhenTheClockGoesBack` (your probe: switched on under 05/12/2027, clock back to 05/12/2026 → `[restoredSilently(2027), arrival(2026)]`, only the 2026 id stored, `activeYear` 2026).

Both tests failed before the fix, against the same test API with the zone read once at init and the `<` sweep (2 failed of 6). Local, iOS 27.0, counts from xcresult: Seasons 39/39; iPhone 18 Pro 1385/1386, the failure being the known load flake `TopicRowActionsTests.aRemovalInFlightIsNotSentTwice`, which passed alone (15/15); iPad Pro 11-inch M5 1386/1386. HFRKit `SettingKeyTests` + `SettingScopeTests` 29/29.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**Adversarial review (Fable 5.1), round 3 on 00a28dd7: APPROVE**

Both round-2 Lows are fixed as classes in the one commit (`git diff 046e0c0b 00a28dd7`: `SeasonalThemeModel.swift`, `SeasonTestSupport.swift`, `SeasonalSweepTests.swift`, the spec):

1. **Live time zone** — `SeasonalThemeModel.swift:72-86, 177`: the model keeps a `timeZone` closure (default `{ .autoupdatingCurrent }`) and rebuilds the Gregorian calendar at each use (`private var calendar`). Every date or key computation in the model goes through it (`sceneDidBecomeActive` :97/:105, `select` :166/:169, `refresh` :198/:199); `NoelCalendar` stays pure and all production callers use the defaults. The spec's "read at each use" now matches the code.
2. **Sweep `activeYear != year`** — `SeasonalThemeModel.swift:99-104`: any other season's theme (earlier, or later from a clock that ran ahead) is restored before the arrival, so two saved themes never coexist and `arrive`'s `!isOn(year)` guard keeps one switch-on per season. No ping-pong when the clock goes forward again: each activation restores at most the one other season pointed at, then switches on at most once (`arrivalShown`); a season whose arrival was consumed under the wrong clock gets its pending alert back but no second switch-on, which is the right outcome. No remaining finding.

**Verified**: worktree at 00a28dd7; app build + 39 Seasons tests green on an iPhone 18 Pro iOS 27.0 simulator (xcresult count); two mutations (zone captured once in `init`; sweep `active < year`) each caught by its new test and nothing else (`aTimeZoneChangeDuringARunIsFollowed`, `aThemeSwitchedOnUnderAClockAheadIsRestoredWhenTheClockGoesBack`; 2/6 red in `SeasonalSweepTests`); no engine change in this commit.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**Adversarial re-check (Fable 5.1) : APPROVE** — head 0d1cc32d (rewrite of 00a28dd7, PR #834, LOT-166 PR 1)

The round-3 APPROVE on 00a28dd7 carries over: the rewrite changes one test file and nothing else.

1. **Detail** — commits 6680708d, 0b522e77, 64182c97, 0d1cc32d: the message of each rebuilt commit ends with one extra `\n` (`git commit-tree` keeps the trailing newline `git log --format=%B` emits; `git commit` would strip it). Trailers and bodies are otherwise byte-identical; `git log`/GitHub render the same; the squash merge composes its own message. No fix needed; next time pipe through `git stripspace` or use `--cleanup`.
2. **Basse** — `Packages/HFRKit/Tests/HFRStorageTests/Sync/SettingScopeTests.swift:44-45`: the five literals sit in an array compared to `keys.map(\.key)`. The `generic-api-key` regex needs `key` followed only by `[ \t\w.-]{0,20}` before the operator, and nothing but `` `'"\s= `` between the operator and the literal: the `)` after `\.key` and the `[` after `==` both break it, so this line is not at risk as written, and CI did not flag it (the failed run 43120342374 reports exactly 2 leaks, lines 73 and 75 of SettingKeyTests at abfcb05d and 046e0c0b). Only a rewrite to `x.key == "season.noel.…"` on one line would re-trigger it. Suggestion, not a request: keep the array form, or build the expected keys from the same kind of helper.

Verified:
- `git diff 00a28dd7 0d1cc32d`: only `SettingKeyTests.swift` (+10/-5): the five `.key == "season.noel.<y>.<n>"` become `noelKey(<y>, "<n>")`, and a file-private `noelKey(_:_:)` (`["season","noel",String(year),name].joined(separator: ".")`, doc comment, 95 cols) is added. The source side keeps its own `SettingKey.noelKey` with string interpolation, so the two are independent.
- `git range-diff 00a28dd7~4..00a28dd7 0d1cc32d~4..0d1cc32d`: same base 9e93c3eb; commits 2 and 4 `=`, commits 1 and 3 `!` on the test file only; authors, author dates, bodies, `Refs #256`, `Co-Authored-By` and `Claude-Session` trailers unchanged (diff of `git log --format` dumps: only hashes and the trailing blank line). The helper is defined in every commit that calls it (1: 5 calls, 2: 5, 3: 6, 4: 6).
- Throwaway worktree: `swift test --filter 'SettingKeyTests|SettingScopeTests'` green at 0d1cc32d, 64182c97 and 6680708d (29 tests, 3 suites).
